title: ReefHub, Kill Aura, Fullbright, Auto Plant, ESP, & More!
features:
🛠️ Main Features:

⚔️ Combat & Kill Aura:

Focus-Fire Kill Aura: Focuses on and kills the nearest mob one-by-one to prevent health desync/predict-reconcile issues.

Advanced Adjustments: Easily customize your attack range and cooldown delay to match your weapon stats.

Deer Stun: Automatically stuns deer and fawns using the HurtDeerTorch remote.

🔥 Campfire Management:

Auto Feed Campfire: Automatically throws burnable fuel (logs, coal) into the main fire to upgrade it and clear the map fog.

Auto Cook: Instantly drops cookable food onto the fire and cooks it.

Auto Scrap: Automatically recycles unwanted items using the CraftingBench grinder.

Realistic Drag & Drop: Uses the native dragging remotes (RequestStartDraggingItem) to ensure items actually fall inside the station's touch zone so the server validates the action.

🎒 Survival & Inventory Utilities:

Auto Bring Items: Teleports ground items (food, medicine, equipment) directly to your character or the campfire.

Auto Plant Seeds: Automatically plants tree seeds and acorns on nearby grass patches.

Auto Eat: Automatically consumes food from your inventory whenever your hunger jauge drops below a custom threshold.

Auto Bag: Automatically packs items on the ground into your Item Bag while monitoring bag capacity.

👶 Rescue & Chests:

Auto Lost Child Rescue: Teleports to the lost child, bags them, carries them back to base, and drops them off safely at the campfire for rewards.

Auto Chest Opener: Instantly teleports to and opens chests (Wood, Silver, Gold) matching your tier filters.

Auto Collect Diamonds: Sweeps the map and automatically collects all diamond pickups.

👁️ Visuals & ESP:

Full ESP (Highlights & Billboards): Renders glowing outlines and name tags for mobs (with live health display), players, chests, items, and lost children.

Fullbright & No Fog: Completely disables nighttime darkness and ambient map fog.

Disable Map Fog-of-War: Instantly turns unexplored FogBlock barriers invisible and non-collidable.

Instant Interact: Removes the hold-duration requirement for all ProximityPrompts across the workspace.

🛡️ Safety & Escape (Anti-Cheat Safeguards):

Owl & Deer Escape: Instantly teleports you back to the safe campfire when targeted by an aggressive owl (OwlChasePlayer) or charging ram (RamChargePlayer).

Player Utilities: Customize WalkSpeed, JumpPower, activate WASD Fly, Noclip, Infinite Jump, and Anti-AFK.

🏰 Match Start & Lobby Automation:

Auto Match Start: Teleports you straight onto active teleporter pads to instantly queue for games.

Lobby Upgrades: Automatically unlocks classes, talents, buys cosmetics, and claims free lobby rewards.

📌 How to Use:

Copy the script from the Script tab.

Open your Roblox executor of choice.

Join 99 Nights in the Forest.

Paste and execute the script.

Press Right Shift on your keyboard to open or close the Axon Hub menu.

Navigate to your desired tab (Combat, Campfire, Farming, etc.) and enable your toggles.

(Mobile, Xeno, and Solara NOT tested.)
